name: maybe_Mem_PoolSlot_Allocate
signature: void* maybe_Mem_PoolSlot_Allocate(PoolOwner* owner, ObjectSlotDesc* desc, uint32_t kind, uint32_t index, uint32_t sub, uint32_t arg6)
summary: Allocates a 0x5880-byte slot from a fixed pool, links it into the owner's slot list and fills the slot header; returns null when the pool is exhausted.
evidence: Callers Gfx_ModelInstance_Init/InitWithTransform and the fixed 0x5880 stride support the pool-slot reading, but the body is damaged (unaff values, bad instruction data) so field semantics cannot be verified.

name: maybe_Gfx_ModelPart_AllocSlots
signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelPart_AllocSlots(GfxModelPart* part, u32 base, u32 count, u32 size, u8 mode)
summary: Carves a model instance's per-part slot arrays out of the resource buffer at base: aligns size, reserves 0x448-byte and 0xD0-byte per-slot tables, then default-constructs the 0x20-byte elements of every 0x100-byte block.
evidence: Only caller Gfx_ModelInstance_BuildSubBlocks passes the same count/size/base it uses for its 0x448-byte sub-block layout; the null destination makes the first parameter damaged.

name: maybe_Sound_Stream_QueueWork
signature: void maybe_Sound_Stream_QueueWork(SoundWorkItem* item, u32 reserved, u32 reserved2, u32 context)
summary: Initialises a sound work item (clears +0x54, self-links +0x7C/+0x80, copies the queue head from +0x14) and enqueues it on the engine's job queue under the queue monitor, signalling the queue afterwards.
evidence: Only caller 0x005543B0 is unnamed and the readable body is damaged (unaff_r4) and overruns into the next function; the disassembly is not trustworthy.

name: maybe_Sound_Voice_ReleaseChannels
summary: Tears a voice down: stops and frees every channel in the voice's channel array except keepChannel, clears the voice state, unlinks it from the mixer list and invokes the owner callback with reason 3.
evidence: Body indexes the second argument as the voice (channel array at +0, count at +8, callback at +0xC) and only compares the first argument against entries; no named caller confirms the role.

name: maybe_Sound_Driver_StopTimer
summary: One-shot shutdown step: when the driver's +0x1F4 flag is set it raises +0x1F7, calls the sound-system accessor and clears +0x1F4.
evidence: Caller is Sound_System_Shutdown so the shutdown role is solid, but the callee 0x517A60 is only a thunk onto Sound_GetSystem and its result is discarded, so nothing in the body says 'timer'.

name: maybe_Sound_Player_Reset
summary: Resets a player to its idle state: unlinks its two driver-queue nodes, finishes and frees any playing note, clears the active/volume flags, releases the pending file request and detaches the driver-registry node.
evidence: Sole caller is Sound_Player_Ctor (0x00550744), which calls it before initialising the player's own fields; every branch is teardown of leftover state.

name: maybe_Sound_SeqPlayer_UpdateActiveNotes
signature: void maybe_Sound_SeqPlayer_UpdateActiveNotes(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 frame, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Consumes the sequence player's active note table: loops entries in the 'ready' state (state byte 3 at +0x241), accumulates their sample offsets into f_58, requeues stream work and starts the next batch of voices.
evidence: No other function refers to it by name; the role rests on the body using the same Sound_Stream_QueueWorkItem / voice-loop layout as the confirmed Sound_SeqPlayer_StartMusic.

name: maybe_Gfx_SamplerState_Write
summary: Writes a three-byte PICA200 texture-sampler state into the draw command stream: mode 0 sets filter 1 / 0x80 / wrap 6, modes 1 and 2 swap the filter and wrap bytes, then the bytes are appended after the element command and the stream cursor at state+4 is updated.
evidence: Callers are generic draw-submit paths Gfx_SubmitSortedElement and Gfx_Overlay_SubmitQuad; state+4 holds a command-stream cursor and the mode switch only chooses the three sampler bytes.

name: maybe_Model_BuildAimPartList
signature: void maybe_Model_BuildAimPartList(u32 owner, u32 partA, u32 partB, u32 partC)
summary: Called only by Model_AttachAimParts; stores four ids in locals and default-constructs two 0x40-byte descriptors in a stack buffer. The body is truncated so the descriptor contents are unknown.
evidence: Only caller is Model_AttachAimParts; visible call is std_ConstructArray(buf, 0x00535B54, 0x40, 2); rest of the 1992-byte body lost.

name: maybe_Fs_Entry_Dtor
summary: Destructor-shaped routine: erases the entry's intrusive list node range and, if the flag at +0x14 is set, erases its red-black-tree node, then returns the entry pointer. No named caller (vtable slot), so the class is unproven.
evidence: Calls Container_List_EraseAllNodes and std_RbTree_EraseNode and returns its argument, matching a two-container destructor; no named callers.

name: Battle2DUnit_RefreshChildPositions
summary: Refreshes derived screen geometry: calls the unit's virtual transform refresh (+0x3C) and child-slot reset (+0x54, index 0), then when the child count exceeds one recomputes the adjusted screen position.
evidence: Caller Battle2DUnit_CalcMoveDuration and callee Battle2DUnit_GetAdjustedScreenPosition; child-count gate via func_00630D64 > 1.

name: Field2D_Actor_RebuildTask
summary: Replaces the actor's task object at +0x88: releases the old task through its vtable, constructs a new task from the state block at +0x38 via Field2D_Task_Init, and stores the result back.
evidence: Called from Field2D_Step_WaitTime; destroys old +0x88 object then calls Field2D_Task_Init on self+0x38.

name: maybe_Field2D_Sprite_SetAppearanceFromCharId
signature: void maybe_Field2D_Sprite_SetAppearanceFromCharId(u32* self, u32 object, u32 arg3, int charId)
summary: Chooses a 2D sprite's appearance (direction frame, palette, draw params) from a character id, falling back to frame 0xFF, and re-resolves draw params via Field2D_Sprite_ComputeDrawParams.
evidence: Character-record lookup func_0063B944 on object+8, 0xFF fallback, and Field2D_Sprite_ComputeDrawParams callee; no named callers.

name: maybe_Field2D_Sprite_AdvancePathStep
summary: Per-frame 2D sprite path update: decrements the step counter at +0x38, then for each of the two path fields at +0x2D0/+0x2D4 chooses a path step and rebuilds the corresponding task object.
evidence: Caller Field2D_Sprite_CheckViewBounds; callee maybe_Field2D_Sprite_ChoosePathStep; decrements counter and swaps task objects for two path programs.

name: maybe_Data_GetFirstRowA
summary: Getter whose return Ghidra dropped: resolves Game_GetDataManager and returns the first row of the manager's +0x884 sub-record table via 0x0063F7BC. One of four identical copies.
evidence: Calls Game_GetDataManager then pure table getter func_0063F7BC; caller Field_NpcJumpAction_Setup only consumes the row pointer; table identity unknown.

name: maybe_Sound_StreamPlayer_InitLock
signature: void maybe_Sound_StreamPlayer_InitLock(SoundStreamPlayer* player, u32 mode, int channelCount, int arg4)
summary: One-time start/lock setup for stream players called from Sound_InitPlayers: if the player flag bit 0 is clear, a channel count was requested and the global lock is free, initialises the critical section at 0x007C8650 and records a handle. Tail lost to bad instruction data.
evidence: Caller Sound_InitPlayers; calls Os_InitCriticalSection and func_00111288; body truncated by halt_baddata.

name: maybe_Gfx_Trail_PushPathNode
signature: void maybe_Gfx_Trail_PushPathNode(Trail* self, int cellX, int cellY, int force)
summary: Appends a reached cell to the trail's 16-entry path ring at +0xF0 (stride 0xC, index +0x1B0), validating the step via Gfx_Trail_TryConnectCell unless forced, then advancing the ring index capped at 15.
evidence: Caller Gfx_Trail_AdvancePathNode and callee Gfx_Trail_TryConnectCell confirm the trail/path-ring role; body still ends in bad instruction data so post-advance bookkeeping is unknown.

name: Field_SceneNode_ShowChildren
summary: Recursively shows a scene node: calls Field_SceneNode_ShowRendererDeep on the node and invokes virtual slot +0x28 (child show) on each child in the +0x1E4 child list.
evidence: Callee is confident Field_SceneNode_ShowRendererDeep; callers include Model_SyncAttachmentVisibilityByState and Ui_EffectHandleList_ReleaseAll; body iterates childTreeRoot/childTreeHead calling vtable +0x28.

name: maybe_Ui_ReleaseActiveSceneObjects
summary: Thunk that fetches the UI core via Ui_GetCore and calls Ui_SceneObject_Release on it; used as a Squirrel-binding destructor callback rather than a UI flow step.
evidence: Callees Ui_GetCore and Ui_SceneObject_Release are confident, but the only caller is Sq_HashTable_Remove, so the 'active scene objects' interpretation is unverified.

name: maybe_Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_SetCharacterId
signature: void maybe_Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_SetCharacterId(SceneSpriteSet* self, unsigned int characterId, unsigned int arg3, int force)
summary: Selects the sprite set's active character id, resolving the 0xD4-stride record and its redirect byte f_D1, then re-applies the preset with the (possibly redirected) id to rebuild the character model/animation.
evidence: Body stores characterId in scenePresetMode, resolves record via 0xD4 stride and f_D1 redirect, and calls Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_ApplyPreset; no callers listed to confirm the character-selection role.

name: maybe_Field_GetActiveSubObject
summary: Accessor returning self+0x98 when the embedded sub-object reports itself active via 0x0066A6BC, otherwise NULL; callers null-check the result before using it.
evidence: Three callers (BG2DDisableMapEffect, Field_ApplySceneFade, maybe_Field2D_Scene_Create) all null-check the result, confirming the optional sub-object contract; owning class of +0x98 still unresolved.

name: Item_SortEntryArray
summary: Sorts a contiguous array of up to 87 4-byte {u16 itemId, u8 count, u8 flags} item entries (bounded by 0x15C bytes or sentinel key) using std_introsort_itemEntry and Item_CompareEntryKey16.
evidence: Operates on 4-byte item entries with Item_CompareEntryKey16 and std_introsort_itemEntry; callers are UI equipment/shop/smith item lists, consistent with item-entry sorting.

name: ItemBag_SortEntriesByKey
summary: Sorts the active 4-byte item entries in ItemBag (+0x2B8..+0x274C, up to 2,341 entries or sentinel key) using std_introsort_itemEntry and Item_CompareEntryKey16.
evidence: self+0x2B8..+0x274C is the canonical ItemBag array (FACTS.md); mirrors ItemBag_SortEntriesBySortKey (0x00611DE4) but uses Item_CompareEntryKey16.

name: maybe_Item_SortU16ListByItemKey
signature: void maybe_Item_SortU16ListByItemKey(WorkData* work, WorkData* container, u32 sentinelKey)
summary: Sorts a list of u16 item IDs starting at container+0x3C4 up to a sentinel key or end bound using std_insertion_sort_u16_item and Item_CompareEntryKey32.
evidence: Sorts u16 item IDs with std_insertion_sort_u16_item and Item_CompareEntryKey32; callers are Field2D map-chip walk triggers and a menu result message, so the item-list role is plausible but not confirmed.

name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_HandleDetailToggle
summary: Toggles detail pane visibility for a list row when flag bit 2 is set; body is truncated by bad instruction data, so the rest is unknown.
evidence: Calls Ui_Widget_SetChildVisible and Ui_ListWindow_ToggleDetailPanes on row->f_14 & 4, but halt_baddata truncates control flow; no callers.

name: maybe_Field_HandleList_Ctor
summary: Constructs a small handle list: installs a vtable, allocates an 8-byte allocator wrapper and a 0x94-byte reader object, so the list owns its allocator/handle pair.
evidence: Vtable install plus Mem_AllocAligned_2 of 8 and 0x94 bytes with func_0058C40C; callers span Ui3D_InitEffectPairFromRecord and Field_Scene_SpawnObjectsFromTableB, so the 'Field' label is weak.

name: maybe_Battle_Unit_ValidateTarget
summary: Validates a battle target: finds it in the unit table at self+0xE8 (stride 0x2C8), resolves its action record via the data manager, and returns 0/1/2 after comparing slot/group/stat fields with the action's target criteria.
evidence: Callers Battle_SelectAiActions and Battle_ActionModel_UpdateAttachmentVisibility; body resolves action rows via Game_GetDataManager and compares ten target fields before returning 0/1/2.

name: maybe_Ui_Plate_FormatPlayerTitle
summary: Formats a nameplate title/honorific prefix from a plate record resolved through the data manager, selecting one of three static string pointers by the record's style byte.
evidence: Only caller Ui_PlateWidget_BindEntry; body picks among g_uiPlatePlayerTitleStrPtrA/B/C by record byte and calls Party_FindEntryByType, but no strings or field names confirm the exact semantics.

name: maybe_DataTable_IsIndexValidA
summary: Bounds check: when the style byte at plate[0] is below 0x1F it fetches the header via 0x0063F93C and returns 0 if the sub-index at plate+0x10 exceeds the header's first limit word; otherwise 1.
evidence: Only caller Party_BuildUsedCharacterList; compares plate+0x10 against *func_0063F93C(dm) and returns 1/0, but the header getter is a mid-function label so the table identity is unproven.

name: maybe_DataTable_GetEntryA
summary: Table accessor: resolves the header with 0x0063F93C, follows its +4 relative pointer and returns the 5-byte entry selected by the sub-index at plate+0x10.
evidence: Only caller Party_BuildUsedCharacterList; returns a pointer into a 5-byte-stride array from the header's +4 section, but the header getter is a mid-function label so the section's meaning stays unknown.

name: maybe_Ui_TestPlacementFree
summary: Resolves the per-record handler via maybe_Field_Placement_GetDefaultArea(record[4]), calls it with (record[0], record[1], record+2, point) and returns the inverted result, so 1 means the cell is free.
evidence: Callers Ui_PlaceWidgetInFreeCell and Field_FindFreePlacementCell2D break on a 1; the handler table and record layout remain opaque.

name: maybe_Item_GetGroupTag
signature: void maybe_Item_GetGroupTag(u32* out, u32 not, u16 itemId)
summary: Writes one of two static u32 item tags into *out: treats the item as grouped when its record is missing or Item_IsSiblingRecord says the next id belongs to the same group, then checks func_00381938(itemId) (0xFFFF = no mapping) to choose between the two tags.
evidence: Item_LookupRecord and Item_IsSiblingRecord confirm item-group membership testing; no item category field (+0x29) is read, so the old 'ByCategory' was wrong, but the meaning of the two global u32 tags is unknown.

name: maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_CopyMarkedBlocks
signature: void maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_CopyMarkedBlocks(uint32_t* dst, const uint32_t* src, int size)
summary: Copies command-buffer blocks of 0x80 words, writing a 0xEAD0FEAD marker after each 0x1FC-byte payload and a length-tagged header for the tail block; returns the new write cursor.
evidence: Marker 0xEAD0FEAD, 0x1FC payload and packed length header visible; no callers and only unverified callee Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureUnits, so the exact command-buffer role stays uncertain.

name: maybe_Gfx_MeshChunk_WritePartMatrices
signature: void maybe_Gfx_MeshChunk_WritePartMatrices(GfxMeshChunkDraw* self, unsigned int** out, GfxMeshPartList* parts, GfxMeshBuffers* buf, GfxDrawTag* tag)
summary: Writes part matrices into the draw command stream in one of three forms (single 0x30-byte matrix DMA bind, gathered multi-matrix block, or palette-merged matrix array).
evidence: Three flag branches, 0x30-byte matrix stride and helper calls are the whole body; callers are UI layout/anim code, so the mesh-chunk role is plausible but not proven.

name: maybe_Sound_Stats_SumPending
summary: Sums the integer counter at node-0x14 over an intrusive list under the sound driver's monitor lock and returns the total; used by the frame profiler and sequence-player active-note update.
evidence: Callers Sound_Profile_RecordFrame and maybe_Sound_SeqPlayer_UpdateActiveNotes plus Os_LockMonitor/Os_UnlockMonitor support a queued-work count, but node geometry is inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_Element_GetSlotIntValue
summary: Calls virtual slot +0x0C of the element interface at self+0x24 and returns its integer result converted to float.
evidence: Virtual slot call and VectorSignedToFloat conversion visible; callers Math_Vector_FixedToFloat/FloatToFixed use it as a tween value fetch, but no caller pins a specific metric.

name: maybe_Field2D_Scene_GetStyleByte18
summary: Getter for the byte at +0x18 of the style/theme record reached through self+4 -> +0x298, consumed by the 2D map scene builder and tile renderer.
evidence: Callers Field2D_Scene_BuildFromMapData and Field2D_Scene_RenderTileGrid confirm 2D map code; record chain and +0x18 offset certain, but the byte's meaning is unknown.

name: maybe_Container_AppendCheckedEntry
summary: Appends an entry to an array builder (store pointer, increment count), calls the builder's acceptance callback, and rolls the count back when rejected.
evidence: Push/increment/rollback sequence unambiguous, but the acceptance callback name Field2D_Sprite_UpdateShadow does not fit a builder and the array-builder role is inferred.

name: maybe_Text_SpanCursor_ClampLine
signature: int* maybe_Text_SpanCursor_ClampLine(int* out, int span, int* cursor)
summary: Clamps a text-span line index to the span's first/last line, writing 0 when the span starts left of the cursor position.
evidence: Callers Text_SpanCursor_Prev/Next support the span-cursor role, but the decompiled body is damaged (removed unreachable blocks, unaff_r7) so bounds and return pointer cannot be trusted.

name: maybe_Text_SpanCursor_PickRandomOffset
signature: int maybe_Text_SpanCursor_PickRandomOffset(int spanOwner, int* cursor, int lineStart)
summary: Picks a signed horizontal offset for a span: random width in [min,max+1] from Math_RandRangeInt, sign from a 0..2 roll, clamps candidates, re-rolls once with opposite sign if zero, returns offset plus lineStart.
evidence: Math_RandRangeInt and span bounds at owner+4+0x10/+0x12 visible, but 5 of 9 callers are Field2D scene builders, so the text-span role is not fully pinned.

name: maybe_Field2D_Scene_GetStyleByte14
summary: Getter for the signed byte at +0x14 of the record reached through self+4 -> +0x298; used by 2D map walk-trigger update and scene builder.
evidence: Two named Field2D callers (Field2D_MapChip_UpdateWalkTrigger, Field2D_Scene_BuildFromMapData); record chain and +0x14 certain, byte meaning unknown.

name: maybe_Work_RowIdIsNamed
signature: u8 maybe_Work_RowIdIsNamed(u32* work, const u32* id)
summary: Predicate over a 20-entry row table testing whether a row id is present; used as a one-byte flag by Ui_ListData_BuildEntries.
evidence: Decompiled body is damaged (only a non-returning wcslen call survives); doc describes a membership test but the code cannot confirm it.

name: maybe_Field2D_Map_MarkLayerFlag
signature: void maybe_Field2D_Map_MarkLayerFlag(void* self, u32 layerId, int enable)
summary: Layer switch helper: scans layer pairs for layerId, sets the layer-changed byte, then refreshes map layer objects.
evidence: Tail call to named Field2D_Scene_AttachLayerObjects and layer-pair scan visible, but middle of body damaged by non-returning std_ConstructArray.

name: Field2D_SpriteNode_Update
summary: Per-frame 2D sprite-node update slot: draws the node then checks view bounds.
evidence: Both callees named (Field2D_SpriteNode_Draw, Field2D_Sprite_CheckViewBounds); no direct caller (vtable slot) so exact slot role uncertain.

name: maybe_Field2D_Map_CreateChipSprite
signature: void* maybe_Field2D_Map_CreateChipSprite(void* self, u32 arg2, void* builder)
summary: Rebuilds the map chip sprite at +0xA0, choosing a tween-move or bob-and-heading sprite based on the chip-kind byte.

summary: Releases the map sprite object and re-initialises the inline node handle at +0x70 via Gfx_ReleaseNodeHandle.
evidence: Callees named (Field2D_SpriteNode_UpdateAnimation, Gfx_ReleaseNodeHandle); decompilation has extraout_r1 damage.

name: maybe_Gfx_SetGlobalPair
summary: Publishes two words into a global pair and re-initialises a critical section with flags 0x04000048; called from Gfx_InitVramBanks.
evidence: Caller Gfx_InitVramBanks and neighbours Gfx_ResetGlobalPair/Gfx_Vram_SetAllocatorWithDefaults; pair contents still unidentified.

summary: Allocates a 0xC0-byte pane object and binds the given pane's children into it; used by Ui_MapWindow_BindPanes.
evidence: Caller Ui_MapWindow_BindPanes and callee Ui_LayoutPane_BindChildren named; allocated class still generic.
